text:
maria: quick idea  what if instead of a 1:1 conversion we run a "conversion ladder" tied to renewal behavior? low friction for onboarding, bigger match if they commit to renew. thoughts?
suresh: sounds promising. ladder = e.g., 80% convert upfront, extra 10% unlocked at renewal, extra 10% if they commit to 12mo reserved. we need to map how marketplace private-offer credits become Redwood reserved SKUs.
ana: ana (finance): ladder introduces timing complexity for revenue recognition. need clear triggers for recognition and a refund clawback if they churn before unlock. will model three scenarios: churn <90d, churn 90180d, renew >=180d.
ben: legal: agree on clawback + no double-dip. also check AWS Marketplace private-offer terms re: converting vendor credits into third-party credits. i'll run vendor T&Cs and draft standard clause.
jess: field/SE: love the ladder for upsell motion. proposal: include SI onboarding voucher (flat $5k) only if they opt into co-sell and use partner for first deployment. SI partner teams prefer explicit eligibility rules.
samir: ops: implementation notes: redeem marketplace token -> verify spend -> create reservation voucher w/ expiration and unlock flags -> emit event. need idempotency and webhook to notify partner. watch for API rate limits and pagination on partner ledger.
billing-bot: billing-bot: created invoice stub BRG-9012 for ladder pilot tracking :white_check_mark:
ana: quick example in pseudo-terms:
```
marketplace_credit: $12,000
upfront_conversion: 0.8 => $9,600 applied to reserved credits
renewal_unlock: 0.1 => $1,200 unlocked if renewal completes within 180d
co_commit_bonus: 0.1 => $1,200 extra if 12mo reserved subscribed
total_possible_reserved_value: $12,000 (at ladder max)
```
jess: product asks: how does this appear in Console? ideally a checkbox during private-offer acceptance: "Convert marketplace credits into Redwood Dedicated reservation credits and enroll in conversion ladder" with a small explainer tooltip. Can we show unlocked amounts and expiration dates?
samir: yes, Console should surface pending unlocks and a small timeline. also expose API for partners to query voucher status.
maria: GTM ask: we need pitch bullets for sellers and partners (why ladder vs straight convert). i'll draft messaging: lower friction, incentivizes renewals, aligns SI co-sell.
ana: accounting action: book 30m with @felix and @leila to align rev-rec and clawback.
ben: legal will circulate redline + marketplace checks by Wed.
suresh: ops action: I'll create infra ticket INF-4720 for SKU mapping + verification workflow, and attach a sample mapping CSV template.
jess: SE: we'll scope two pilot accounts (one AWS private-offer, one Azure private-offer) and coordinate SI integration.
maria: timeline: aim for 6-week pilot. deliverables this week: legal redline, billing prototype stub, console UX mock, SE partner list. objections?
jess: no objections. starting SE outreach now.
ana: fine with timeline but finance needs the churn scenarios by Fri.
maria: thanks all. if no further notes I'll brief execs next Tue with pilot plan.
